description: The Committee can no longer distribute City of Saskatoon materials.
It will create its own flyers with QR codes linking to city website.
Robin Steeg resigned from the Committee.

chips.text: A committee member felt restricting materials was a lost opportunity for education.
Committee members questioned the rationale for restricting city material distribution.
Committee sought more clarity on the new rules for distributing information.
New rules impact the committee's ability to share environmental education.

description: City reviews sump pump discharge issues from high groundwater.
New options for storm connections or city-led mitigation are explored.
Industry feedback will inform future development standards.

chips.text: It's not easy because everybody wants a basement in high groundwater areas.
Residents in new developments like Brighton are affected by sump pump discharge.
Unclear if city can force developers to disclose high groundwater to buyers.
Residents are frustrated by saturated green spaces and icy sidewalks from discharge.
Sharing private groundwater data could lead to legal issues with developers.
City staff will engage industry this summer on potential sump pump solutions.
